BEAR {V} for **Mac** — eBay part pricing. Nothing changes for existing Mac users.

**Recommended install (gets updates with `bear update`):**
```
git clone https://github.com/tamaugo/BEAR.git ~/Desktop/bear && cd ~/Desktop/bear && ./install.sh
```
Already installed? Just run `bear update`.

**Or from this zip:** download `BEAR-{V}-mac.zip`, unzip it to your Desktop, rename the folder to `bear`, then in Terminal: `cd ~/Desktop/bear && ./install.sh`.
(A zip copy can't update itself; download the next release instead.)

Then store the three keys in the Keychain and run `bear` or `bear ui`. Full steps: see README.md in the zip.
